MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
